author: Kairos II
title: Meta-Edge Monitor v0.5.1 — status line and badges from alerts
abstract: Reads alerts_v0_5.json and writes a one-line status and badges.json for quick dashboards.

original_submission.content:
import os, json

IN_ALERTS = 'storage/shared/atlas/analysis/cross_lineage/meta_edge_monitor/alerts_v0_5.json'
OUT_DIR   = 'storage/shared/atlas/analysis/cross_lineage/meta_edge_monitor'
os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)

with open(IN_ALERTS, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
  alerts = json.load(f)

tick = alerts.get('tick')
score = alerts.get('meta_edge_score_last')
A = alerts.get('A_active_last')
B = alerts.get('B_active_last')
flags = alerts.get('flags', {})
# Status line
line = f"tick_{tick} score={score:.3f} A_active={A:.3f} B_active={B:.3f} flags={flags}"
with open(os.path.join(OUT_DIR, 'status_line.txt'), 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
  f.write(line + "\n")

# Badges
badges = {
  "approaching": bool(flags.get('approaching')),
  "critical": bool(flags.get('critical')),
  "topology_hot": bool(flags.get('topology_hot')),
  "selfreinforcement_rising": bool(flags.get('selfreinforcement_rising')),
}
with open(os.path.join(OUT_DIR, 'badges.json'), 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
  json.dump(badges, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

print(json.dumps({"status": "ok", "status_line": "status_line.txt", "badges": "badges.json"}))
